command:
set -euo pipefail; ADB=adb; SERIAL=$($ADB devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}'); test -n "$SERIAL"; MODEL=$($ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r'); test "$MODEL" = 'SM-S906B'; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path io.blueeye >/dev/null; OUT="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/tracker/checkpoints/ui-p0-baseline-20260912"; mkdir -p "$OUT"; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell input keyevent KEYCODE_WAKEUP || true; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell wm dismiss-keyguard || true; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop io.blueeye; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell monkey -p io.blueeye -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null; sleep 3; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" exec-out screencap -p > "$OUT/radar-baseline.png"; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/tracker-p0-radar.xml >/dev/null; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" pull /sdcard/tracker-p0-radar.xml "$OUT/radar.xml" >/dev/null; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
import re, hashlib
out=Path.home()/"agent-workspace/repos/tracker/checkpoints/ui-p0-baseline-20260912"
root=ET.parse(out/"radar.xml").getroot()
c=[]
for n in root.iter():
    if n.attrib.get('clickable')!='true': continue
    m=re.fullmatch(r'\[(\d+),(\d+)\]\[(\d+),(\d+)\]',n.attrib.get('bounds',''))
    if not m: continue
    x1,y1,x2,y2=map(int,m.groups()); w=x2-x1; h=y2-y1
    if w>=650 and h>=90 and y1>=180 and y2<=2150:
        c.append((y1,x1,x2,y2))
c.sort()
print('RADAR_LARGE_CLICKABLES',len(c))
if not c: raise SystemExit('No plausible Radar card clickable found')
y1,x1,x2,y2=c[0]
x=(x1+x2)//2; y=(y1+y2)//2
(out/"card-tap.txt").write_text(f'{x} {y}\n')
for name in ('radar-baseline.png',):
    p=out/name; print(name,'bytes',p.stat().st_size,'sha256',hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
print('SELECTED_CARD_CENTER',x,y)
PY
read X Y < "$OUT/card-tap.txt"; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap "$X" "$Y"; sleep 2; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" exec-out screencap -p > "$OUT/details-baseline.png"; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/tracker-p0-details.xml >/dev/null; $ADB -s "$SERIAL" pull /sdcard/tracker-p0-details.xml "$OUT/details.xml" >/dev/null; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,re
out=Path.home()/"agent-workspace/repos/tracker/checkpoints/ui-p0-baseline-20260912"
p=out/"details-baseline.png"
xml=(out/"details.xml").read_text(errors='replace')
markers=['Signal','Identity','Evidence','Details','Follow','RSSI','Technical']
hits=[m for m in markers if re.search(m,xml,re.I)]
print('DETAILS_MARKER_HITS',len(hits),','.join(hits))
print('details-baseline.png','bytes',p.stat().st_size,'sha256',hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
PY
$ADB -s "$SERIAL" shell input keyevent BACK; sleep 1; echo DEVICE_UI_BASELINE_CAPTURE_PASS MODEL=$MODEL OUT=$OUT
